answer: An operator running 174 keys hence burns for 174 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the yarrow quota and the haven admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 3 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the wander ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
